name: Post-Holiday Soothing Hot Ginger & Peppermint Herbal Tea
whyItWorks: Steeped fresh ginger root and dried peppermint leaves. Gingerols reduce gastrointestinal mucosal inflammation and nausea, while menthol calms colon spasms. Zero caffeine, zero acid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 tea bag or fresh ginger slices in hot water for 5 minutes; sweeten with a teaspoon of pure honey.
